title: Leadership payment on the map
description: Paying for Leadership command tokens by clicking planets on the map: ringed payable planets, a payment bar with paid against the bill, the panel's list kept in sync, and the confirm rules. Agenda influence voting is unchanged.

shots.heading: Panel: Pay on the map
shots.caption: One token bought on the Leadership panel. Auto-pay planned Lodor; the new Pay on the map button minimises the panel so planets can be clicked. The Change payment list stays as before.

shots.heading: Map: Auto-pay staged
shots.caption: Panel minimised. Planets that can pay are ringed with their influence (Jord 2, Lodor 3, Quann 1); Lodor, Auto-pay's pick, is staged. The bar shows Paid 3 / 3 influence, Covered, and Confirm tokens and purchase is enabled. Nothing is sent yet.

shots.heading: Nothing selected
shots.caption: Lodor clicked off: no planet is staged, Paid 0 / 3, 3 remaining, Confirm is disabled.

shots.heading: Partially covered
shots.caption: Jord staged (2 of 3): 1 remaining, a problem line says to stage more, Confirm is disabled.

shots.heading: Exactly covered
shots.caption: Jord and Quann (2 + 1) staged instead of Lodor: Paid 3 / 3, Covered, Confirm is enabled.

shots.heading: Over-covered
shots.caption: Lodor and Jord staged (5 against 3): the bar says Overpaying by 2 and that the engine would stop asking once the bill is covered, so Confirm is disabled until one is taken out (the panel enforces the same rule).

shots.heading: Two tokens: insufficient
shots.caption: Two tokens bought (bill 6, all the influence there is); Quann clicked off leaves 5 of 6: Short by 1, Confirm disabled.

shots.heading: Panel list in sync
shots.caption: After the map clicks, the panel is reopened: its planet list shows Jord and Quann pressed and Lodor not, the same selection, with the account line agreeing.

shots.heading: Phone width
shots.caption: The exactly-covered state at 390 px wide: the map with ringed planets and the bar with its tally and actions.

notes: Fixtures are synthetic, not captured engine states.
Auto-pay's suggestion is unchanged; the map starts from it.
